A quick google search reveals that 1/12 of a 9in diameter, single layer, chocolate cake is 340 calories before frosting. This is a double layer and she ate a 1/4. So we multiply by 3 to bring it up to 1020. Then multiply by 2 to bring it up to 2040 kcal. The surface area for that quarter was about 67 inches squared. Eyeballing that the frosting was on average about 1/2 inch thick, that means she ate 38.5 cubic inches of frosting. So that's 1.33 pints of what is basically straight sugar. One cup of sugar has 773 calories. Multiply by 2.6 to get back to 1.33 pints. 2009.8 kcal.

So this little snacky reward for being good all week came to a (estimated) total of about 4050 kcal.
